trumpRule: CODEX 48: Every defect must cite the chain event that contains the supporting fact. P0 = title failure — no commitment issues until cured. Defect log is append-only.

canvasTabs.label: Open Defects
canvasTabs.description: Live defect registry — only open defects (no title.defect_cured event). Sorted by severity: P0 first (RED), P1 (YELLOW), P2 (GREY). Each card: severity chip, one-line description, evidence event IDs (clickable to chain of title), suggested cure, days open, assigned to. P0 count = blocking RED badge. Zero open defects = GREEN 'Title clean — no open defects' hero. Log new defect button (AI-assisted: describe it, AI cites evidence from chain events, submits title.defect_logged).

canvasTabs.label: Curative
canvasTabs.description: Curative action tracker. Each open P0/P1 defect has a cure checklist: required documents, responsible party, due date, status. P0 cure examples: IRS lien release from county recorder, heirship affidavit + probate order, corrective deed. P1 cure examples: payoff letter + release, HOA estoppel letter, survey. Upload cure docs here — upload writes a title.defect_cured chain event. Progress bar: X of Y defects cured.

canvasTabs.label: Defect History
canvasTabs.description: Full append-only defect log — all defects including cured ones. Filter: All / P0 / P1 / P2 / Open / Cured. Each entry: severity, description, logged timestamp, evidence, cure action taken, cured timestamp + cure document reference. Export to PDF for the file. Audit trail per TX RAAS rules.

canvasTabs.label: Risk Summary
canvasTabs.description: Visual risk dashboard. Gauge: overall title risk score. Defect count by severity (P0/P1/P2 as three stacked bars). Days to estimated cure (based on defect types + typical cure timelines). Risk narrative (plain English: 'This title has one P0 defect — an unreleased IRS lien. Cure time estimate: 5-10 business days.'). Handoff: when all P0s cured → 'Ready for final commitment' button → re-commitment-001.
